game.q: a companion asks, “even you?” what does he call his tears?

wrong.weak: no. he never treated tears as weakness.
wrong.test: gently, no. he called them something kind.

game.right: YES. “it is mercy,” he said. the tears came from the same place as his kindness.

end.line: he held his little son, wept, and called the tears mercy.

cliff.s1: next, a mother searching a crowd.
cliff.tmr: tomorrow: more merciful than a mother.

share: a father wept for his baby son and called his tears mercy. the story on infinite hill
